audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claims Fiora owns every stage except a 'Skill' level 6, but the packet chart and the page's own whys say Kassadin takes levels 3-5 and everything from first item onward.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Fiora, Fiora, Kassadin, Kassadin, Fiora, Kassadin, Kassadin; whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] all describe Kassadin ahead, and whys[4] calls level 6 Fiora's last owned window.
audit.corrected: win[2], win[3], win[5], win[6] -> Kassadin; win[4] -> Fiora; matching phases[N].side and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown advice was generic — no real numbers for Riftwalk, Riposte or Grand Challenge.
audit.why: Kassadin R is 5/3.5/2s with an escalating mana cost per recast; Fiora W is 24/22/20/18/16 and R is 110/90/70.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now carry 5s Riftwalk, 24s Riposte and 110s Grand Challenge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nether Blade is an auto-attack reset and the page never says so; and dosFull[2] implies Riposte does something special to Riftwalk.
audit.why: Riot's text: Nether Blade's active empowers his NEXT basic attack, so the wind-up animation is the tell, not a cast. Riposte only stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect — nothing in Kassadin's kit immobilizes, so it can never stun him.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names the auto-reset wind-up as the step-back cue; dosFull[2].d no longer implies a parry stun.

edits.before: Once Null Sphere is leveled, its silence interrupts your Lunge-chain mid-combo and his Nether Blade mana sustain lets him farm through your poke — all-in only when his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Null Sphere's silence interrupts your Lunge-chain mid-combo, and Nether Blade (7s) sustains his mana through poke — its auto-reset wind-up, not a cast, is your cue to step out.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — 5s at rank 1 and cheap only once, so his second blink is the punish window. - Riposte: 24s at rank 1, spend it on his commit. - Grand Challenge: 110s — kill windows only.

edits.before: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His level-6 spike. Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 — punish the second blink, when the mana cost doubles.

edits.before: Kassadin wastes Riftwalk — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Once he blinks in, commit the full pattern — his blink is spent.
